coefficient_spaces_and_cross_grid_norms.weight_reason: submultiplicative polynomial weight supports a finite-smoothness Chebyshev convolution algebra without claiming analyticity of flat remainders
coefficient_spaces_and_cross_grid_norms.multiplication_bound: the canonical coefficient convolution has operator norm at most 1 from l1_8 times l1_8 to l1_8 because w_(m+n) and w_(abs(m-n)) are each at most w_m*w_n
coefficient_spaces_and_cross_grid_norms.basis_derivative_identity: T_k'=k*U_(k-1); the sum of absolute canonical T coefficients of U_(k-1) is exactly k
coefficient_spaces_and_cross_grid_norms.derivative_loss: for s>=2, norm_(s-2)(d_x f)<=norm_s(f); in particular order 8 maps to 6 with constant 1 and two x derivatives map to order 4 with constant 1
